_comment: Copy to manifest.json and fill in as you hand-drive each instance through Litos.Gui. shape must be one of: single_file, multi_file_conditional, fan_out (ReadMe_PTCPersistentKernel.md §1.1's task-shape categories). session_dir is the {sessionId}/ folder Litos wrote under ~/.litos/sessions/{owner}/{sessionId}/ -- find it via /resume's session list or the transcript store directly. patch_path is a file you save yourself via `git diff > patch.txt` in the checkout, right after each run.
